A_core_direct_lifespan.title: A low dose of dietary resveratrol partially mimics caloric restriction and retards aging parameters in mice.
evidence_quotes: We fed individually-housed male (C57BL/66C3H/He)F1 hybrid mice one of three diet formulations: a control diet (84 kcal mouse21 week21), a CR diet (63 kcal mouse21 week21) and a control diet supplemented with trans-resveratrol (4.9 mg kg21 day21) starting at middle age (14 months of age).
We have previously reported that this CR regimen started at middle age in this strain leads to a 13% increase in average and maximum lifespan [10].

B_disease_model_survival.title: Idebenone and resveratrol extend lifespan and improve motor function of HtrA2 knockout mice.
evidence_quotes: Idebenone or Resveratrol were suspended in 0.5% methylcellulose (Sigma, Taufkirchern, Germany) and mixed into the mash, at 500 mg/kg body weight for Idebenone and as 25 mg/kg body weight for Resveratrol per day.
Feeding HtrA2 knockout mice with either compound extends lifespan and delays worsening of the motor phenotype.
